spec.purpose: Model preparation and task settings for the six-method submission dataset

training.selection: none: final epoch 400 of every series

ridge.rule: family setting = min mean validation NMSE over the selection seeds after the per-seed ridge choice; per-seed lambda by validation; an edge selection is recorded, never extended; online results never adjust these settings

eta.center: 1e-3 * g_dense / g_family, g = mean selection-seed training feature energy of the final-epoch models
eta.edge_rule: an edge selection is reported with code grid_edge; the grid is not extended

online.protocol: A1 -> B30 -> catch1 (adapt off) -> washout5 (adapt on)

data.split_rule: dataset.train_val_split(seed=model seed); shared by all families

audit_set.use: offline quality record only; never used for selection

checkpoint_config.selection: none: epochs 200 and 400 are fixed; no validation-best replacement
